description: This file defines the SugarSprites class, which manages sprite metadata within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform. It implements a singleton pattern, loads sprite metadata from cache files, and maintains internal data structures for sprites and directories.

classes.name: SugarSprites
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for loading and managing sprite metadata used in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM theme system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor that initializes default sprite directories and loads associated metadata.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the singleton instance of SugarSprites.

methods.name: loadSpriteMeta
methods.description: Loads sprite metadata for a specified directory if not already loaded.

methods.name: loadMetaHelper
methods.description: Helper method to include and process sprite metadata files from the cache.
